methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Bring a large pan of water to a boil over high heat. Carefully place the pork side (belly), skin side down, in the pan and return to a boil. Add half the salt, then reduce the heat to medium and simmer for 30 minutes. Transfer to a wire rack, let rest for 5-10 minutes, then pierce the skin all over with a fork. Rub with the vinegar, then the remaining salt. Score the skin in a 1 cm crisscross pattern and set aside. Preheat the oven to 375°F/190°C/Gas Mark 5. Transfer the seasoned pork to a large roasting pan, skin side up, and roast for about 11⁄2 hours. Remove and set aside.

Meanwhile, make the sauce. Bring 250 ml water, the broth (stock), and cilantro (coriander) root to a boil in a pan over medium heat. Add the remaining ingredients except the cornstarch (cornflour) and boil for 5 minutes or until the mixture has slightly reduced and is thoroughly combined.
Dissolve the cornstarch in 4 tablespoons water and add to the pan, stirring well. Let the sauce boil for another 2 minutes or until thickened.

Heat the oil in a skillet or frying pan over medium heat. Sauté the pork, skin side down, for 2-3 minutes or until the skin is puffed up and crisped, then turn and saute the other side for another 1-2 minutes. Remove, drain, and let cooL.
Slice the cooled pork into bite-size pieces and place on top of the rice. Pour over the sauce and serve with the egg and cucumber.

recipes.title: Deep-Fried Salted Chicken
recipes.subtitle: North

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 400 g boneless chicken thighs, cut into 2.5 cm cubes
1 teaspoon granulated sugar pinch of white pepper
2 red spur chiles, diagonally sliced, to garnish

ingredientGroups.heading: For the roasted chili dip
lines: 10 dried red bird's eye chiles, seeded

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Combine the chicken, garlic, soy sauce, salt, pepper, and sugar in a bowl. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 10-15 minutes.

For the chili dip, toast the dried chiles in a wok over medium heat for 2-3 minutes, or until fragrant and dark. Remove and set aside. Toast the garlic and shallot for 2-3 minutes, or until soft and lightly burned.

Transfer the garlic and shallot to a mortar. Add the toasted chiles, galangal, and shrimp paste and pound until smooth. Add the fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, and 2 tablespoons water and stir well. Transfer to a serving bowl.

Heat the oil for deep-frying to 350°F/180°C. Deep-fry the chicken for 8-10 minutes, or until golden and crisp. Drain on paper towels, garnish with the sliced red chiles, and serve with the roasted chili dip.

recipes.title: Raw Soft-Shell Crab in Fish Sauce
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 10-15 red and green bird's eye chiles, chopped

ingredientGroups.heading: To serve
lines: 1 bitter gourd, peeled and thinly sliced
3 cloves garlic, peeled and left whole

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Rinse the crabs under cold running water.

Using a pair of sharp scissors, cut off the front part of the crab behind the eyes, then open the top shell and remove and discard the gills. Turn the crab over and remove the apron. Repeat with the remaining crabs.

Place the crabs on a plate with 3 tablespoons fish sauce. Cover with plastic wrap (clingfilm) and let marinate in the refrigerator for 2 hours. Pound the garlic and the chiles together in a mortar with a pestle. Add the lime juice, sugar, and the remaining fish sauce and stir until thoroughly combined.
Place the marinated crabs on a serving plate and drizzle with the sauce, Arrange the bitter gourd around the crabs and sprinkle with the mint and the whole garlic cloves. Serve.

recipes.title: Spicy Water Spinach and Shrimp Salad
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 4 uncooked jumbo shrimp (king prawns), peeled and deveined, with tails still intact
3 red finger chiles, sliced into fine strips

ingredientGroups.heading: For the batter
lines: 120 g wheat flour pinch of salt pinch of ground black pepper

ingredientGroups.heading: For the sauce
lines: 1 tablespoon jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: To make the batter, put the flour, salt, and black pepper into a bowl and stir to combine. Add 175 ml water and stir until a batter forms.
Coat the water spinach in the batter.

Heat the oil for deep-frying in a wok or deep fryer to 350°F/180°C or until a cube of bread browns in 30 seconds. Gradually add the coated water spinach to the hot oil, and deep- fry for 4-5 minutes or until cooked. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Deep-fry the shrimp (prawns) for 2-3 minutes or until cooked. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Set aside. For the sauce, bring the coconut milk and fish sauce to a boil in a separate wok over medium heat. Add the sugar, chili jam, and lime juice stir, and return to a boil. Remove from the heat.
To serve, place the deep-fried water spinach and shrimp on a serving plate and pour over the sauce. Sprinkle with the chiles and fried shallots and serve.

recipes.title: Pork Floss Wrapped in Kale Leaves

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 5 cm piece fresh ginger, peeled and cut into 1 cm dice
10-15 red and green bird's-eye chiles, finely chopped

ingredientGroups.heading: For the sweet-and-sour dressing
lines: 21⁄2 tablespoons jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: For the dressing, mix the sugar, fish sauce, lime juice, and pickled plum juice, if using, in a pan over medium heat. Stir for about 2 minutes, or until the sugar has dissolved and starts to caramelize. Let cool.
Mix the ginger, chiles, shallots, lemongrass, roasted peanuts, limes, pork floss, and dressing together in a large bowl.
To serve, place the kale leaves on a serving plate and put a teaspoon of the pork mixture into the center of each leaf.

recipes.title: Spicy Raw Shrimp in Fish Sauce
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 15 raw shrimp, peeled and deveined with tails intact
5 red and green bird's-eye chiles, to garnish
100 g sliced bitter gourd, to garnish
5 garlic cloves, thinly sliced lengthwise, to garnish

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Arrange the uncooked shrimp (prawns) on a serving plate.

Mix the fish sauce with 11⁄2 tablespoons water in a bowl, then pour over the shrimp. Cover the plate with plastic wrap (clingfilm) and chill in the refrigerator for 30-50 minutes or until the shrimp have absorbed the sauce.
To serve, pour the seafood sauce over the shrimp and garnish with the chiles, bitter gourd, garlic, and mint leaves.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Angled Gourd with Egg

1 teaspoon fish sauce à teaspoon granulated sugar

steps: Heat the oil in a wok over high heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for 30 seconds or until fragrant. Add the gourds and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes. Add the eggs and stir-fry for another minute or until the eggs are cooked. Add the oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce, and sugar and mix well. Serve.

steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the tofu, and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes or until golden. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside. Reserve 2 tablespoons of the oil, then drain the rest from the wok. Increase the heat to medium-high and heat the reserved oil. Add the garlic and bean sprouts and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes. Add the chiles, scallions (spring onions), oyster sauce, soy sauce, and tofu and stir-fry for another 1 minute. Serve.

steps: Cut through the basa fish belly and remove the innards, then cut the fish into slices and rinse under cold running water. Drain and set aside.

Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the chile mixture and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the sliced fish and stir-fry for 8 minutes. Add the remaining ingredients and stir-fry for 2 minutes. Serve.

methodGroups.heading: Method

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Small Horse Mussels

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Sort through the mussels and discard any with open shells. Scrub the mussels with a scourer to remove any barnacles and then pull away the beards.

Increase the heat a little, add the mussel meat, soy sauce, and sugar, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until the mussels are cooked. Add the basil leaves and stir-fry for another 1 minute. Serve.

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 100 g dry salted fish (Spanish mackerel), rinsed, dried, and cut into bite-size pieces

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Rinse the Chinese broccoli, then trim the ends of the stems and discard. Cut the stems from the leaves, then slice the stems and leaves diagonally into 4 cm pieces. Set aside.

Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat, add the garlic, and saute for 30 seconds. Add the fish and sauté for 1 minute or until cooked. Add the broccoli, oyster sauce, and sugar and stir-fry for another 2 minutes. Serve.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Broccoli with Salted Fish Central 400 g Chinese broccoli 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 3 cloves garlic, chopped 100 g dry salted fish (Spanish mackerel), rinsed, dried, and cut into bite-size pieces 1 tablespoon oyster sauce 1 teaspoon granulated sugar Rinse the Chinese broccoli, then trim the ends of the stems and discard. Cut the stems from the leaves, then slice the stems and leaves diagonally into 4 cm pieces. Set aside. Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat, add the garlic, and saute for 30 seconds. Add the fish and sauté for 1 minute or until cooked. Add the broccoli, oyster sauce, and sugar and stir-fry for another 2 minutes. Serve.

recipes.title: Spicy Stir-Fried Pickled Shrimp
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 2 shallots, finely sliced dried red chiles, seeded, to garnish (optional) Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378), to serve

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the pickled shrimp, eggs, bird's eye chiles, and shallot and mix well. Stir-fry for 3 minutes. Transfer to a serving dish, sprinkle with dried red chiles, if using, and serve with rice.

recipes.searchText: Spicy Stir-Fried Pickled Shrimp Central 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 2 tablespoons pickled shrimp 2 eggs, beaten 5-7 red bird's eye chiles 2 shallots, finely sliced dried red chiles, seeded, to garnish (optional) Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378), to serve Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the pickled shrimp, eggs, bird's eye chiles, and shallot and mix well. Stir-fry for 3 minutes. Transfer to a serving dish, sprinkle with dried red chiles, if using, and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Spicy Stir-Fried Seafood
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 80 ml fish or chicken broth, plus extra if needed
150 g raw shrimp, peeled and deveined with tails intact
150 g squid, cleaned and cut into 1 cm-thick rings
1 sawtooth cilantro sprig, chopped Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378), to serve

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the lemongrass and galangal, and sauté for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the chili jam and fry for another 1 minute or until fragrant, then add the mushrooms and stir-fry for another 1 minute. Add the broth (stock), shrimp (prawns), and squid and stir-fry for 3 minutes. Season with the fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, chiles, and kaffir lime leaves. Stir-fry for another 1 minute, then add the sawtooth cilantro (coriander) and stir until thoroughly combined. Transfer to a serving plate or shallow bowl and add a little more broth. Serve with rice.

Add the chili jam and fry for another 1 minute or until fragrant, then add the mushrooms and stir-fry for another 1 minute. Add the broth (stock), shrimp (prawns), and squid and stir-fry for 3 minutes. Season with the fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, chiles, and kaffir lime leaves. Stir-fry for another 1 minute, then add the sawtooth cilantro (coriander) and stir until thoroughly combined. Transfer to a serving plate or shallow bowl and add a little more broth. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Melinjo Leaves and Dried Shrimp
recipes.subtitle: South

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 100 g melinjo leaves or young spinach

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the shallot and garlic, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the melinjo leaves, eggs, oyster sauce, soy sauce, sugar, and salt and stir-fry for 3 minutes. Add the dried shrimp and stir-fry until thoroughly cooked. Serve.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Melinjo Leaves and Dried Shrimp South 3 tablespoons vegetable oil 1 small shallot, chopped 3 cloves garlic, chopped 100 g melinjo leaves or young spinach 2 eggs, beaten. 1 tablespoon oyster sauce 1 teaspoon soy sauce 2 teaspoons granulated sugar 1 teaspoon salt 20 g dried shrimp Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the shallot and garlic, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the melinjo leaves, eggs, oyster sauce, soy sauce, sugar, and salt and stir-fry for 3 minutes. Add the dried shrimp and stir-fry until thoroughly cooked. Serve.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Blue Crab with Curry Powder
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 2 Chinese celery stalks, cut into 3 cm pieces
3 scallions (spring onions), cut into 3 cm pieces

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Put the crabs in the freezer for 20 minutes. Humanely kill each crab by turning it onto its back and piercing through the small hole beneath the tail flap with a sturdy skewer.
Cook the crabs in boiling water for 2-3 minutes, then transfer to cold water and let cool. Remove and discard the apron and carapace, rinse clean, and chop each crab into quarters.
Whisk all the sauce ingredients together in a bowl and set aside.
Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and onion and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the chile and sauté for about 10 seconds, then add the crab and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Pour in the sauce and cook for another 2 minutes. Add the celery and scallions and cook for 1 minute more, then serve.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Blue Crab with Curry Powder Central 2 x 300 g live blue crabs 3 tablespoons vegetable oil 3 cloves garlic, chopped 1 onion, sliced lengthwise 2 red spur chiles, diagonally sliced 2 Chinese celery stalks, cut into 3 cm pieces 3 scallions (spring onions), cut into 3 cm pieces 350 ml whole milk 1 egg 1 tablespoon Chili Jam (see p. 35) 2 teaspoons curry powder 2 tablespoons oyster sauce 1⁄4 teaspoon ground white pepper 1 teaspoon granulated sugar 1 teaspoon soy sauce Put the crabs in the freezer for 20 minutes. Humanely kill each crab by turning it onto its back and piercing through the small hole beneath the tail flap with a sturdy skewer. Cook the crabs in boiling water for 2-3 minutes, then transfer to cold water and let cool. Remove and discard the apron and carapace, rinse clean, and chop each crab into quarters. Whisk all the sauce ingredients together in a bowl and set aside. Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and onion and sauté for 1 minute. Add the chile and sauté for about 10 seconds, then add the crab and cook for 1-2 minutes. Pour in the sauce and cook for another 2 minutes. Add the celery and scallions and cook for 1 minute more, then serve.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Shrimp with Garlic Sauce
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 300 g uncooked shrimp (prawns), peeled and deveined

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Put the shrimp (prawns) and salt in a bowl, mix well, and let marinate for 5 minutes.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat, add the shrimp, and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until golden brown. Transfer to a serving plate and set aside.

Remove all but 3 tablespoons of the oil from the wok. Add the garlic and sautê for 1 minute or until golden, then add the butter, peppercorns, soy sauce, and oyster sauce, and sauté for about 30 seconds. Add 2 tablespoons water, mix for another 20 seconds, then pour the garlic sauce over the shrimp. Garnish with the cilantro (coriander) sprigs and serve.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Shrimp with Garlic Sauce Central 300 g uncooked shrimp (prawns), peeled and deveined 1⁄2 teaspoon salt 120 ml vegetable oil 10 cloves garlic, coarsely chopped 1 tablespoon butter 1 tablespoon white peppercorns, crushed 1 teaspoon soy sauce 11⁄4 tablespoons oyster sauce 2 cilantro (coriander) sprigs, to garnish Put the shrimp (prawns) and salt in a bowl, mix well, and let marinate for 5 minutes. Heat the oil in a wok over high heat, add the shrimp, and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until golden brown. Transfer to a serving plate and set aside. Remove all but 3 tablespoons of the oil from the wok. Add the garlic and sautê for 1 minute or until golden, then add the butter, peppercorns, soy sauce, and oyster sauce, and sauté for about 30 seconds. Add 2 tablespoons water, mix for another 20 seconds, then pour the garlic sauce over the shrimp. Garnish with the cilantro (coriander) sprigs and serve.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Mushrooms, Baby Corn, and Shrimp
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 8-10 shrimp, peeled and deveined, with tails intact
14 baby corn, sliced diagonally into 4 cm lengths

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add the garlic and stir-fry for 30 seconds or until fragrant.
Add the shrimp and stir-fry for 1 minute or until cooked. Remove and set aside.
Add the baby corn to the wok and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until softened, adding 60 ml water while stir-frying.
Add the mushrooms and stir-fry for another minute, then return the shrimp to the wok. Add the soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, and scallion and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Serve.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Mushrooms, Baby Corn, and Shrimp Central 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 2-3 cloves garlic, chopped 8-10 shrimp, peeled and deveined, with tails intact 14 baby corn, sliced diagonally into 4 cm lengths 100 g termite mushrooms, sliced 1 teaspoon soy sauce 2 tablespoons oyster sauce 1⁄2 teaspoon superfine sugar 1 scallion, sliced into 3 cm lengths Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add the garlic and stir-fry for 30 seconds or until fragrant. Add the shrimp and stir-fry for 1 minute or until cooked. Remove and set aside. Add the baby corn to the wok and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until softened, adding 60 ml water while stir-frying. Add the mushrooms and stir-fry for another minute, then return the shrimp to the wok. Add the soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, and scallion and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Serve.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Squid with Sator Beans
recipes.subtitle: South

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 200 g squid, cleaned and cut into small pieces
1 tablespoon jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar
200 g sator or chopped green beans

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the chili jam, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the squid, salt, and sugar and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes or until cooked. Add the sator or green beans and chiles and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes or until cooked. Serve.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Squid with Sator Beans South 1 tablespoon vegetable oil 2 tablespoons Chili Jam (see p. 35) 200 g squid, cleaned and cut into small pieces 1⁄2 teaspoon salt 1 tablespoon jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar 200 g sator or chopped green beans 10 red finger chiles Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the chili jam, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the squid, salt, and sugar and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes or until cooked. Add the sator or green beans and chiles and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes or until cooked. Serve.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Fiddlehead Ferns and Dried Squid
recipes.subtitle: South

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Soak the dried squid in a bowl of warm water for 30 minutes until soft. Drain, then cut into 1 cm slices and set aside.
Blanch the fern leaves in a pan of boiling water for 1 minute. Drain and plunge immediately into cold water. Drain and set aside.

Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant and golden. Add the squid, soy sauce, oyster sauce, and ferns and stir-fry for about 3 minutes until cooked. Serve.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Fiddlehead Ferns and Dried Squid South 1 large dried squid 400 g Fiddlehead ferns, washed 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 7 cloves garlic, chopped 1 tablespoon soy sauce 1 tablespoon oyster sauce Soak the dried squid in a bowl of warm water for 30 minutes until soft. Drain, then cut into 1 cm slices and set aside. Blanch the fern leaves in a pan of boiling water for 1 minute. Drain and plunge immediately into cold water. Drain and set aside. Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant and golden. Add the squid, soy sauce, oyster sauce, and ferns and stir-fry for about 3 minutes until cooked. Serve.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Squid
recipes.subtitle: South

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 1 x 400 g squid, cleaned and sliced into 1 cm thick rings, tentacles reserved
10 scallions (spring onions), white part only, sliced
1 tablespoon small pickled garlic cloves lettuce leaves, to serve

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Pound the garlic, shallot, shrimp paste, and white pepper in a mortar with a pestle until a smooth paste.

Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the paste, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Increase the heat to medium-high, add the squid rings and tentacles, and stir-fry for another 5 minutes. Add the scallions (spring onions), oyster sauce, fish sauce, and sugar and mix well. Add the pickled garlic and stir-fry for another 30 seconds, then serve on a bed of lettuce.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Squid South 5 cloves garlic 2 shallots, chopped 5 teaspoons shrimp paste 1⁄2 teaspoon ground white pepper 3 tablespoons vegetable oil 1 x 400 g squid, cleaned and sliced into 1 cm thick rings, tentacles reserved 10 scallions (spring onions), white part only, sliced 11⁄2 tablespoons oyster sauce 1 tablespoon fish sauce 1 teaspoon granulated sugar 1 tablespoon small pickled garlic cloves lettuce leaves, to serve Pound the garlic, shallot, shrimp paste, and white pepper in a mortar with a pestle until a smooth paste. Add the pickled garlic and stir-fry for another 30 seconds, then serve on a bed of lettuce.

recipes.title: Spicy Stir-Fried Beef with Peppers
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 150 g sliced beef tenderloin or fillet

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the beef, and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes until cooked. Add the remaining ingredients and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes. Serve.

recipes.searchText: Spicy Stir-Fried Beef with Peppers Central 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 150 g sliced beef tenderloin or fillet *green bell pepper, seeded and sliced 1 green finger chile, sliced 1 red finger chile, sliced *onion, sliced 80 g Jew's ear mushrooms sliced 1 teaspoon fish sauce 1 teaspoon soy sauce 1 teaspoon oyster sauce 1⁄2 teaspoon granulated sugar 80 ml vegetable broth (stock) Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the beef, and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes until cooked. Add the remaining ingredients and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes. Serve.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Beef with Broccoli in Oyster Sauce
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 150 g sirloin or tenderloin beef, cut into 5 mm thick slices
400 g Chinese broccoli, cut into 2-inch 5 cm lengths

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the beef and stir-fry for 1 minute, then season with the oyster sauce and soy sauce, and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Add the broccoli and 2 tablespoons water and stir-fry for another 2 minutes or until the broccoli has softened slightly. Serve.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Beef with Broccoli in Oyster Sauce Central 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 3 cloves garlic, finely chopped 150 g sirloin or tenderloin beef, cut into 5 mm thick slices 21⁄2 tablespoons oyster sauce 1 tablespoon soy sauce 400 g Chinese broccoli, cut into 2-inch 5 cm lengths Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. recipes.title: Stir-Fried Cabbage, Pork, and Tofu
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 125 g egg tofu (see p. 170), cut into 2 cm-thick slices
500 g bok choy (pak choi), cut into 6-7 cm lengths
1⁄2 teaspoon ground black pepper A pinch of granulated sugar
70 g Chinese celery, cut into 3 cm lengths Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378), to serve

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Spread the flour on a plate and dredge the tofu in it until well coated.
Heat 475 ml oil in a wok or deep fryer to 350°F/180°C. Reduce the heat to medium and deep-fry the tofu for 4-5 minutes, until golden brown. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Combine the oyster sauce and soy sauce in a small bowl.

Heat the remaining 3 tablespoons oil in a clean wok over medium-high heat. Add the garlic and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Add the pork and stir-fry for about 1 minute, until it begins to brown. Add the bok choy and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the oyster-soy mixture, broth, black pepper, sugar, and celery. Stir well, add the tofu, and gently stir for another 40-50 seconds. Serve with rice.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Cabbage, Pork, and Tofu Central 30 g all-purpose (plain) flour 125 g egg tofu (see p. 170), cut into 2 cm-thick slices 475 ml vegetable oil, plus 3 tablespoons 1 tablespoon oyster sauce 21⁄2 teaspoons soy sauce 3 cloves garlic, finely chopped 150 g ground (minced) pork 500 g bok choy (pak choi), cut into 6-7 cm lengths 3 tablespoons vegetable broth (stock) 1⁄2 teaspoon ground black pepper A pinch of granulated sugar 70 g Chinese celery, cut into 3 cm lengths Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378), to serve Spread the flour on a plate and dredge the tofu in it until well coated. Add the pork and stir-fry for about 1 minute, until it begins to brown. Add the bok choy and stir-fry for 2 minutes. Add the oyster-soy mixture, broth, black pepper, sugar, and celery. Stir well, add the tofu, and gently stir for another 40-50 seconds. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Sweet Stir-Fried Pork
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 500 g pork belly, cut into 1 cm-thick slices
75 g jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar
2 teaspoons ground black pepper Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378) or Shrimp Paste Fried Rice (see p. 383), to serve

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute, until fragrant and golden.
Add the pork and stir-fry for 6-7 minutes, until cooked.
Add the light soy sauce, oyster sauce, dark soy sauce, sugar, and black pepper and stir well.
Reduce the heat slightly and cook for 5 minutes, until the liquid reduces and caramelizes. Serve with steamed jasmine rice or shrimp paste fried rice.

recipes.searchText: Sweet Stir-Fried Pork Central 3 tablespoons vegetable oil 5 garlic cloves, finely chopped 500 g pork belly, cut into 1 cm-thick slices 2 tablespoons light soy sauce 2 tablespoons oyster sauce 21⁄2 tablespoons dark soy sauce 75 g jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar 2 teaspoons ground black pepper Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378) or Shrimp Paste Fried Rice (see p. 383), to serve Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the light soy sauce, oyster sauce, dark soy sauce, sugar, and black pepper and stir well. Reduce the heat slightly and cook for 5 minutes, until the liquid reduces and caramelizes. Serve with steamed jasmine rice or shrimp paste fried rice.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Crispy Pork with Red Chili Paste
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 250 g Crispy Pork Side (see p. 314), cut into bite-size pieces
45 g yard-long beans, cut into 3 cm lengths
1 handful sweet basil leaves Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378), to serve

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the curry paste and stir-fry for 1 minute, or until fragrant.
Add the pork, yard-long beans, oyster sauce, fish sauce, 1-2 tablespoons water, and sugar. Stir-fry for 2 minutes, or until the beans are cooked.
Add the basil and stir a few times until combined. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Crispy Pork with Salted Shrimp
recipes.subtitle: South

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 2-3 red and green bird's-eye chiles, chopped
250 g Crispy Pork Side (see p. 314), cut into bite-size pieces

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and chiles and stir-fry for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the salted shrimp and sugar and mix well. Add the crispy pork and stir-fry for 2 minutes. Serve.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Crispy Pork with Salted Shrimp South 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 2 garlic cloves, chopped 2-3 red and green bird's-eye chiles, chopped 2 tablespoons salted freshwater shrimp 2 tablespoons granulated sugar 250 g Crispy Pork Side (see p. 314), cut into bite-size pieces Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. recipes.title: Stir-Fried Pork with Basil, Rice, and Fried Egg
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 100 g pork loin or shoulder, sliced into bite-size pieces
1 yard-long bean, sliced into 2 cm lengths
To serve Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378)

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Pound the chiles and garlic together in a mortar with a pestle, then set aside. Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the pounded chile mixture, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the pork and stir-fry for 3 minutes. Add the yard-long bean, soy sauce, sugar, and oyster sauce and stir-fry for about 1 minute. Add the basil leaves, stir-fry briefly and remove from the heat.
To serve, arrange the steamed rice on a serving plate, place the pork on top of the rice, and put the fried eggs on top of the pork.

recipes.title: Phat Thai without Noodles
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 100 g extra-firm white or yellow tofu, cut into 1 cm cubes
100 g pork shoulder or pork loin, thinly sliced
10 uncooked shrimp (prawns), peeled and deveined with tails intact
2-3 tablespoons roasted peanuts, finely pounded, plus extra to garnish
2 Chinese chives, cut into 4 cm pieces Cilantro (coriander) sprigs, to garnish Raw vegetables, such as Chinese chives, bean sprouts, and banana blossom, to serve Lime wedges, to serve

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the oil in a wok or deep fryer to 180°C. Deep-fry the tofu for 4-5 minutes, until golden brown. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Drain all but 3 tablespoons oil from the wok. Heat over medium heat, add the shallot, and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the pork and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until cooked. Add the pickled radish and fresh shrimp and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes, until the shrimp are cooked.
Add the eggs and cook for 10 seconds. Add the dried shrimp and fried tofu and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Increase the heat slightly. Add the sugar, lime juice, fish sauce, pounded peanuts, fresh chiles, and chile flakes and quickly stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the bean sprouts and chives and stir 2-3 times. Transfer to a serving dish, garnish with the extra peanuts and cilantro, and serve with the raw vegetables and lime wedges.

Heat over medium heat, add the shallot, and stir-fry for 1 minute. Add the pork and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until cooked. Add the pickled radish and fresh shrimp and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes, until the shrimp are cooked. Add the eggs and cook for 10 seconds. Add the dried shrimp and fried tofu and stir-fry for 1 minute. Increase the heat slightly. Add the sugar, lime juice, fish sauce, pounded peanuts, fresh chiles, and chile flakes and quickly stir-fry for 1 minute. Add the bean sprouts and chives and stir 2-3 times. Transfer to a serving dish, garnish with the extra peanuts and cilantro, and serve with the raw vegetables and lime wedges.

recipes.title: Spicy Stir-Fried Pork Side
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 400 g pork belly, cut into 1 cm-thick pieces
1 tablespoon jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar
5 kaffir lime leaves, finely sliced Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378), to serve

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over high heat. Add the pork and stir-fry for 6-7 minutes, until cooked and beginning to brown.
Remove the pork with a slotted spoon, reduce the heat to medium, and add the curry paste. Stir-fry for about 1 minute, until fragrant.
Return the pork to the wok and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until coated with the paste.
Add the sugar and fish sauce and stir until the sugar dissolves. Add the kaffir lime leaves and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Serve with rice.

recipes.searchText: Spicy Stir-Fried Pork Side Central 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 400 g pork belly, cut into 1 cm-thick pieces 2 tablespoons Red Curry Paste (see p. 38) 1 tablespoon jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar 1 tablespoon fish sauce 5 kaffir lime leaves, finely sliced Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378), to serve Heat the oil in a wok over high heat. Add the pork and stir-fry for 6-7 minutes, until cooked and beginning to brown. Remove the pork with a slotted spoon, reduce the heat to medium, and add the curry paste. Stir-fry for about 1 minute, until fragrant. Return the pork to the wok and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until coated with the paste. Add the sugar and fish sauce and stir until the sugar dissolves. Add the kaffir lime leaves and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Spicy Stir-Fried Pork Tenderloin
recipes.subtitle: North

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 5 red or green finger chiles, diagonally sliced

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the pork and soy sauce and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, until cooked.
Add the sugar and chiles and stir-fry for another minute. Serve.

recipes.searchText: Spicy Stir-Fried Pork Tenderloin North 11⁄2 tablespoons vegetable oil 3 cloves garlic, finely chopped 350 g pork tenderloin, thinly sliced 1 tablespoon soy sauce 1 teaspoon granulated sugar 5 red or green finger chiles, diagonally sliced Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute, until fragrant. Add the pork and soy sauce and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, until cooked. Add the sugar and chiles and stir-fry for another minute. Serve.

recipes.title: Spicy Stir-Fried Pork with Basil
recipes.subtitle: North

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Coarsely pound the chiles and garlic together in a mortar, then set aside.
Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the pounded chile mixture and stir-fry for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the pork, soy sauce, and sugar and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, until cooked.
Add the basil leaves, mix well, and serve.

recipes.searchText: Spicy Stir-Fried Pork with Basil North 10 red and green bird's-eye chiles 5 cloves garlic 11⁄2 tablespoons vegetable oil 200 g ground pork 1⁄2 teaspoon soy sauce 1⁄2 teaspoon granulated sugar 50 g sweet basil leaves Coarsely pound the chiles and garlic together in a mortar, then set aside. Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the pounded chile mixture and stir-fry for 1 minute, until fragrant. Add the pork, soy sauce, and sugar and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, until cooked. Add the basil leaves, mix well, and serve.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Chicken with Siam Cardamom Shoots
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 200 g African basil leaves and flowers, pounded
1 kg chicken, cut into small pieces
200 g orange finger chiles, sliced into long strips

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the oil a wok over medium heat, add the curry paste, basil leaves, and chicken, and stir-fry for about 10 minutes. Add the pea eggplants (aubergines), finger chiles, kaffir lime leaves, cardamom shoots, fish sauce, and about 3 tablespoons water and cook for another 3 minutes. Serve.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Chicken with Siam Cardamom Shoots Central 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 3-4 tablespoons Red Curry Paste (see p. 38) 200 g African basil leaves and flowers, pounded 1 kg chicken, cut into small pieces 500 g pea eggplants 200 g orange finger chiles, sliced into long strips 100 g kaffir lime leaves, chopped 500 g Siam cardamom shoots 2 tablespoons fish sauce Heat the oil a wok over medium heat, add the curry paste, basil leaves, and chicken, and stir-fry for about 10 minutes. Add the pea eggplants (aubergines), finger chiles, kaffir lime leaves, cardamom shoots, fish sauce, and about 3 tablespoons water and cook for another 3 minutes. Serve.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Pork in Oyster Sauce
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 400 g pork shoulder, cut into 2 mm-thick slices

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Mix the pork, egg, tapioca flour, oyster sauce, soy sauce, sugar, and brandy or whiskey in a large bowl. Cover and marinate for 10 minutes.
Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the marinated pork and stir-fry for 1 minute. Add 60 ml water and stir-fry for another 3-4 minutes, until the pork is cooked.
Add the scallions and stir for 30 seconds. Serve.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Pork in Oyster Sauce Central 400 g pork shoulder, cut into 2 mm-thick slices 1 egg, beaten 2 teaspoons tapioca flour 23⁄4 tablespoons oyster sauce 11⁄2 teaspoons soy sauce 1⁄2 teaspoon granulated sugar 11⁄2 teaspoons brandy or whiskey 3 tablespoons vegetable oil 6 cloves garlic, finely chopped 3 scallions, cut into 4 cm lengths Mix the pork, egg, tapioca flour, oyster sauce, soy sauce, sugar, and brandy or whiskey in a large bowl. Cover and marinate for 10 minutes. Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute, until fragrant. Add the marinated pork and stir-fry for 1 minute. Add 60 ml water and stir-fry for another 3-4 minutes, until the pork is cooked. Add the scallions and stir for 30 seconds. Serve.

recipes.title: Spicy Stir-Fried Chicken and Coconut
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 300 g boneless chicken breast, cut into bite-size pieces
1 teaspoon jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar
50 g sweet basil leaves Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378), to serve

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Break open the coconuts and scoop out the coconut meat with a spoon. Cut the meat into bite-size pieces and soak in a bowl of water.
Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the curry paste, and stir-fry for 1 minute, or until fragrant.
Carefully add 3-4 tablespoons water and the chicken and stir-fry for 5 minutes, or until cooked.
Add the coconut meat and 60 ml water, mix, and cook for about 4 minutes.
Add the fish sauce and sugar, then stir and cook for 4 minutes, until the chicken has softened.
Add the basil leaves and mix well. Serve with rice.

recipes.searchText: Spicy Stir-Fried Chicken and Coconut Central 5 young coconuts 3 tablespoons vegetable oil 2 tablespoons Red Curry Paste (see p. 38) 300 g boneless chicken breast, cut into bite-size pieces 3 tablespoons fish sauce 1 teaspoon jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar 50 g sweet basil leaves Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378), to serve Break open the coconuts and scoop out the coconut meat with a spoon. Cut the meat into bite-size pieces and soak in a bowl of water. Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the curry paste, and stir-fry for 1 minute, or until fragrant. Carefully add 3-4 tablespoons water and the chicken and stir-fry for 5 minutes, or until cooked. Add the coconut meat and 60 ml water, mix, and cook for about 4 minutes. Add the fish sauce and sugar, then stir and cook for 4 minutes, until the chicken has softened. Add the basil leaves and mix well. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Chicken with Eggplant
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 250 g chicken thighs, bone-in, chopped into bite-size pieces
4 yellow round eggplants (aubergines), quartered, stems discarded
4 green round eggplants (aubergines), quartered, stems discarded
11⁄2 tablespoons fish sauce A pinch of granulated sugar A pinch of salt
50 g sweet basil leaves Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378), to serve

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat a wok over medium heat, add the curry paste, and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
Add the chicken and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
Add the eggplants, fish sauce, sugar, salt, and 2-3 tablespoons water and stir-fry for about 3 minutes, or until the eggplants have softened.
Add the chiles and stir-fry for 1 minute. Serve with rice.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Chicken with Eggplant Central 11⁄2 tablespoons Red Curry Paste (see p. 38) 250 g chicken thighs, bone-in, chopped into bite-size pieces 4 yellow round eggplants (aubergines), quartered, stems discarded 4 green round eggplants (aubergines), quartered, stems discarded 11⁄2 tablespoons fish sauce A pinch of granulated sugar A pinch of salt 3 green spur chiles, diagonally sliced 50 g sweet basil leaves Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378), to serve Heat a wok over medium heat, add the curry paste, and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant. Add the chicken and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes. Add the eggplants, fish sauce, sugar, salt, and 2-3 tablespoons water and stir-fry for about 3 minutes, or until the eggplants have softened. Add the chiles and stir-fry for 1 minute. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Chicken with Cashew Nuts
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 3 dried red spur chiles, seeded and cut into 4 cm pieces
400 g skinless boneless chicken thigh or breast, cut into bite-size pieces

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over low-medium heat, add the cashew nuts, and fry for 5-6 minutes or until golden brown. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.

Add the dried chiles to the wok and fry for 20-30 seconds or until fragrant and the color turns darker. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Add the chicken to the wok and fry for about 5 minutes or until cooked and golden brown. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.

Drain all but 1 tablespoon of oil from the wok then heat the oil over medium heat. Add the onion and stir-fry for 1 minute. Add the oyster sauce and sugar, mix well, then add the chicken, cashew nuts, and scallions (spring onions) and stir for 1 minute. Remove from the heat, sprinkle with the fried dried chiles, and serve.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Chicken with Cashew Nuts Central 250 ml vegetable oil 150 g raw cashew nuts 3 dried red spur chiles, seeded and cut into 4 cm pieces 400 g skinless boneless chicken thigh or breast, cut into bite-size pieces 1⁄2 small onion, sliced 2 tablespoons oyster sauce 1 teaspoon granulated sugar 4 scallions, cut into 4 cm lengths Heat the oil in a wok over low-medium heat, add the cashew nuts, and fry for 5-6 minutes or until golden brown. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Add the dried chiles to the wok and fry for 20-30 seconds or until fragrant and the color turns darker. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Add the chicken to the wok and fry for about 5 minutes or until cooked and golden brown. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Drain all but 1 tablespoon of oil from the wok then heat the oil over medium heat. Add the onion and stir-fry for 1 minute. Add the oyster sauce and sugar, mix well, then add the chicken, cashew nuts, and scallions (spring onions) and stir for 1 minute. Remove from the heat, sprinkle with the fried dried chiles, and serve.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Ginger Chicken
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 300 g skinless boneless chicken breast, cut into 7 mm-thick slices
1 × 7 cm piece fresh ginger, peeled and julienned

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the chicken and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes until almost cooked. Add the soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, and mushrooms, and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until the chicken is cooked. Adding 2 tablespoons water if the sauce dries out. Add the ginger, black pepper, scallion (spring onion), and chiles and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Serve.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Ginger Chicken Central 3 tablespoons vegetable oil 3 garlic cloves, chopped 300 g skinless boneless chicken breast, cut into 7 mm-thick slices 1 teaspoon soy sauce 2 tablespoons oyster sauce 1 teaspoon granulated sugar 100 g Jew's ear mushrooms, chopped 1 × 7 cm piece fresh ginger, peeled and julienned 1⁄2 teaspoon ground black pepper 1 scallion, cut into 2.5 cm pieces 2 red spur chiles, sliced Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the chicken and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes until almost cooked. Add the soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, and mushrooms, and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until the chicken is cooked. Adding 2 tablespoons water if the sauce dries out. Add the ginger, black pepper, scallion (spring onion), and chiles and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Serve.

recipes.title: Spicy Stir-Fried Straw Mushroom Salad
recipes.subtitle: North

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 3 scallions (spring onions), chopped Mint leaves, chopped Glutinous Rice (see p. 378), to serve Raw or steamed vegetables, such as cucumber, Chinese greens, yard-long beans, and lettuce, to serve

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Pound the chili paste, shrimp paste, and salt together in a mortar with a pestle until smooth. Set aside.
Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and quickly stir-fry for 30 seconds, until fragrant.
Add the chili paste and sauté for 3 minutes, until fragrant. Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Add the mushrooms and sugar and cook for 5 minutes.
Transfer to a serving bowl and sprinkle with the shallot, both cilantro, scallions, and mint. Serve with glutinous rice and raw or steamed vegetables.

recipes.searchText: Spicy Stir-Fried Straw Mushroom Salad North 1 tablespoon Larb Chili Paste (see p. 41) 1⁄2 teaspoon shrimp paste 3⁄4 teaspoon salt 1 tablespoon vegetable oil 3 cloves garlic, chopped 175 ml chicken broth (stock) 500 g straw mushrooms, halved 1⁄4 teaspoon granulated sugar 1 shallot, halved and finely sliced 1 sawtooth cilantro (coriander) sprig, chopped 1 cilantro (coriander) sprig, chopped 3 scallions (spring onions), chopped Mint leaves, chopped Glutinous Rice (see p. 378), to serve Raw or steamed vegetables, such as cucumber, Chinese greens, yard-long beans, and lettuce, to serve Pound the chili paste, shrimp paste, and salt together in a mortar with a pestle until smooth. Set aside. Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and quickly stir-fry for 30 seconds, until fragrant. Add the chili paste and sauté for 3 minutes, until fragrant. Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil. Add the mushrooms and sugar and cook for 5 minutes. Transfer to a serving bowl and sprinkle with the shallot, both cilantro, scallions, and mint. Serve with glutinous rice and raw or steamed vegetables.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Silkworm Pupae
recipes.subtitle: Northeast

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 200 g uncooked shrimp (prawns), peeled and deveined, with tails still intact
5 bell peppers, seeded and cut into large dice

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Soak the mushrooms in a bowl of water for 30 minutes, then drain and rinse. Set aside.

Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, shrimp (prawns), and silkworm pupae and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes. Add the cucumbers, soaked mushrooms, bell peppers, fish sauce, vinegar, sugar, and ketchup and stir well.

Combine the cornstarch (cornflour) and 3 tablespoons of water and add to the wok along with the tomatoes, onion, and scallions (spring onions). Stir-fry for 1 minute, then add the mulberries and stir again. Sprinkle with the red chiles, cilantro (coriander), and white pepper and serve.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Silkworm Pupae Northeast 10 dried cloud ear mushrooms, halved 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 10 cloves garlic, sliced 200 g uncooked shrimp (prawns), peeled and deveined, with tails still intact 300 g silkworm pupae, washed 10 baby cucumbers, quartered 5 bell peppers, seeded and cut into large dice 1 teaspoon fish sauce 1 teaspoon white vinegar 2 tablespoons superfine (caster) sugar 2 tablespoons ketchup (optional) 1 tablespoon cornstarch (cornflour) 2 tomatoes, quartered 1 onion, chopped 5 scallions (spring onions), chopped 15-20 mulberries 2 red spur chiles, thinly sliced 5 cilantro (coriander) sprigs 1 teaspoon ground white pepper Soak the mushrooms in a bowl of water for 30 minutes, then drain and rinse. Set aside. Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, shrimp (prawns), and silkworm pupae and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes. Add the cucumbers, soaked mushrooms, bell peppers, fish sauce, vinegar, sugar, and ketchup and stir well. Combine the cornstarch (cornflour) and 3 tablespoons of water and add to the wok along with the tomatoes, onion, and scallions (spring onions). Stir-fry for 1 minute, then add the mulberries and stir again. Sprinkle with the red chiles, cilantro (coriander), and white pepper and serve.

recipes.title: Fried King Oyster Mushrooms
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 200 g king oyster mushrooms, rinsed and sliced
5 uncooked shrimp (prawns), peeled and deveined, with tails still intact
4 scallions (spring onions), cut into 1-inch 2.5 cm lengths

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the mushrooms, oyster sauce, and broth (stock) and stir-fry for 1 minute. Add the soy sauce, sugar, and shrimp (prawns) and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes or until the shrimp are cooked. Add the scallions (spring onions), stir well, then serve.

recipes.searchText: Fried King Oyster Mushrooms Central 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 7 cloves garlic, chopped 200 g king oyster mushrooms, rinsed and sliced 1 tablespoon oyster sauce 3 tablespoons chicken broth (stock) 11⁄2 teaspoons soy sauce 1 teaspoon granulated sugar 5 uncooked shrimp (prawns), peeled and deveined, with tails still intact 4 scallions (spring onions), cut into 1-inch 2.5 cm lengths Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the mushrooms, oyster sauce, and broth (stock) and stir-fry for 1 minute. Add the soy sauce, sugar, and shrimp (prawns) and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes or until the shrimp are cooked. Add the scallions (spring onions), stir well, then serve.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Chayote Leaves and Shiitake Mushrooms
recipes.subtitle: North

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 200 g chayote stems and leaves, chopped
11⁄2 tablespoons oyster sauce Pinch of ground white pepper

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Make a cross on the top of the mushrooms. Heat the oil in a wok over high heat, add the chayote leaves and mushrooms, and stir-fry for about 1 minute. Add the oyster sauce, white pepper, fried garlic, soy sauce, and chicken broth (stock) and stir-fry for about 1 minute until well mixed and the chayote leaves have softened. Serve.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Chayote Leaves and Shiitake Mushrooms North 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 200 g chayote stems and leaves, chopped 8 shiitake mushrooms 11⁄2 tablespoons oyster sauce Pinch of ground white pepper 1⁄2 tablespoon Fried Garlic (see p. 64) 1 tablespoon soy sauce 80 ml chicken broth Make a cross on the top of the mushrooms. Heat the oil in a wok over high heat, add the chayote leaves and mushrooms, and stir-fry for about 1 minute. Add the oyster sauce, white pepper, fried garlic, soy sauce, and chicken broth (stock) and stir-fry for about 1 minute until well mixed and the chayote leaves have softened. Serve.

recipes.title: Spicy Stir-Fried Mushrooms with Basil
recipes.subtitle: South

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 300 g abalone mushrooms, rinsed and chopped

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Finely pound the garlic and chiles in a mortar with a pestle and set aside. Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the pounded mixture, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the remaining ingredients. Stir-fry for about 3 minutes until thoroughly combined, then serve.

recipes.searchText: Spicy Stir-Fried Mushrooms with Basil South 10 cloves garlic 15 red bird's eye chiles 3 teaspoons vegetable oil 300 g abalone mushrooms, rinsed and chopped 1 tablespoon oyster sauce 1 teaspoon light soy sauce 50 g sweet basil leaves 1 teaspoon granulated sugar Finely pound the garlic and chiles in a mortar with a pestle and set aside. Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the pounded mixture, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the remaining ingredients. Stir-fry for about 3 minutes until thoroughly combined, then serve.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Shiitake Mushrooms
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 250 g fresh shiitake mushrooms, stems trimmed and mushrooms halved
3 scallions (spring onions), chopped into 4 cm lengths

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the mushrooms and stir-fry for 2 minutes or until cooked. Add the remaining ingredients and stir-fry for another 1 minute. Serve.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Shiitake Mushrooms Central 2-3 tablespoons vegetable oil 3 cloves garlic, finely chopped 250 g fresh shiitake mushrooms, stems trimmed and mushrooms halved 21⁄2 tablespoons oyster sauce 1 teaspoon soy sauce 60 ml chicken broth (stock) 3 scallions (spring onions), chopped into 4 cm lengths Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the mushrooms and stir-fry for 2 minutes or until cooked. Add the remaining ingredients and stir-fry for another 1 minute. Serve.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Straw Mushrooms with Pork
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 5 scallions (spring onions), cut into2.5-5 cm lengths

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Put the pork, garlic, and soy sauce into a large bowl and mix well. Cover with plastic wrap (clingfilm) and let marinate in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.

Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the marinated pork, and stir-fry for 2 minutes until half cooked. Add the mushrooms, chile, scallions (spring onions), and oyster sauce and stir-fry for 2 minutes, or until cooked. Serve.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Straw Mushrooms with Pork Central 350 g pork tenderloin, finely sliced 6 cloves garlic, finely chopped 2 tablespoons soy sauce 1 tablespoon vegetable oil 100 g fresh straw mushrooms, halved 1 red finger chile, quartered 5 scallions (spring onions), cut into2.5-5 cm lengths 3 tablespoons oyster sauce Put the pork, garlic, and soy sauce into a large bowl and mix well. Cover with plastic wrap (clingfilm) and let marinate in the refrigerator for 30 minutes. Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the marinated pork, and stir-fry for 2 minutes until half cooked. Add the mushrooms, chile, scallions (spring onions), and oyster sauce and stir-fry for 2 minutes, or until cooked. Serve.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Eggplant with Ground Pork
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 2 x 300 g long green eggplants (aubergines), cut crosswise into 5 cm pieces and quartered lengthwise
50 g sweet basil leaves Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378), to serve

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute, or until fragrant. Add the pork and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the eggplants and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes, adding 2-3 tablespoons water as they cook. Add the sugar, soy sauce, oyster sauce, and salted soybeans and stir until combined.
Cover and cook for another 2 minutes. Add both chiles and the basil and stir briefly. Serve with rice.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Eggplant with Ground Pork Central 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 1 clove garlic, chopped 100 g ground (minced) pork 2 x 300 g long green eggplants (aubergines), cut crosswise into 5 cm pieces and quartered lengthwise 1⁄2 teaspoon granulated sugar 1 teaspoon soy sauce 1 tablespoon oyster sauce 11⁄2 teaspoons salted soybeans 1 red spur chile, diagonally sliced 1 green spur chile, diagonally sliced 50 g sweet basil leaves Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378), to serve Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute, or until fragrant. Add the pork and stir-fry for 1 minute. Add the eggplants and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes, adding 2-3 tablespoons water as they cook. Add the sugar, soy sauce, oyster sauce, and salted soybeans and stir until combined. Cover and cook for another 2 minutes. Add both chiles and the basil and stir briefly. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Jicama
recipes.subtitle: South

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 200 g uncooked shrimp, peeled and deveined, tails intact
200 g squid, cleaned and sliced, tentacles removed
300 g jicama or white radish, peeled and finely julienned

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute, until fragrant and golden.
Add the shrimp and squid and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until cooked.
Add the jicama or white radish and stir-fry for another 3 minutes. Season with the sugar, oyster sauce, fish sauce, and salt.
Add the scallions and carrot and stir until thoroughly mixed. Serve.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Jicama South 3 tablespoons vegetable oil 7-10 cloves garlic, chopped 200 g uncooked shrimp, peeled and deveined, tails intact 200 g squid, cleaned and sliced, tentacles removed 300 g jicama or white radish, peeled and finely julienned 1 tablespoon granulated sugar 1 tablespoon oyster sauce 1 tablespoon fish sauce 1⁄2 teaspoon salt 2-3 scallions, cut into 2.5 cm pieces 175 g julienned carrot Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute, until fragrant and golden. Add the shrimp and squid and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until cooked. Add the jicama or white radish and stir-fry for another 3 minutes. Season with the sugar, oyster sauce, fish sauce, and salt. Add the scallions and carrot and stir until thoroughly mixed. Serve.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Bitter Gourd and Egg
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 200 g bitter gourd, peeled, halved lengthwise, and cut into 2 mm slices
1 teaspoon granulated sugar Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378), to serve

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Mix the salt and bitter gourd together in a large bowl. Set aside for 15 minutes, then rinse twice with water and drain.

Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for 30 seconds or until fragrant Increase to the heat to high, add the bitter gourd, and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until softened. Add the eggs and stir-fry for about 1 minute or until cooked. Season with the soy sauce and sugar and stir-fry for another 1-2 minutes. Serve with rice.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Bitter Gourd and Egg Central 2 tablespoons salt 200 g bitter gourd, peeled, halved lengthwise, and cut into 2 mm slices 1 tablespoon vegetable oil 3 garlic cloves, crushed 2 eggs, beaten 1 tablespoon soy sauce 1 teaspoon granulated sugar Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378), to serve Mix the salt and bitter gourd together in a large bowl. Set aside for 15 minutes, then rinse twice with water and drain. Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for 30 seconds or until fragrant Increase to the heat to high, add the bitter gourd, and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until softened. Add the eggs and stir-fry for about 1 minute or until cooked. Season with the soy sauce and sugar and stir-fry for another 1-2 minutes. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Lotus Stems with Shrimp
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 8 raw shrimp, peeled and deveined with tails intact
250 g young lotus stems, peeled and cut into 4 cm lengths
1 tablespoon salted soybeans Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378), to serve

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the shrimp (prawns) and lotus stems, increase the heat, and cook for 1-2 minutes until cooked. Add the fish sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, and soybeans, stir, and serve with rice.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Lotus Stems with Shrimp Central 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 3 garlic cloves, chopped 8 raw shrimp, peeled and deveined with tails intact 250 g young lotus stems, peeled and cut into 4 cm lengths 1 tablespoon fish sauce 11⁄2 tablespoons oyster sauce 1 tablespoon granulated sugar 1 tablespoon salted soybeans Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378), to serve Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the shrimp (prawns) and lotus stems, increase the heat, and cook for 1-2 minutes until cooked. Add the fish sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, and soybeans, stir, and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Spicy Stir-Fried Jackfruit
recipes.subtitle: North

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 400 g young jackfruit, peeled and seeded wearing gloves, and cut into 3 cm slices
5 kaffir lime leaves, chopped, to garnish

ingredientGroups.heading: For the chili paste
lines: 15 dried red chiles, seeded a be as poon salt

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: For the chili paste, soak the dried chiles in a bowl of warm water for 15 minutes or until rehydrated, then drain and chop.
Pound the chiles, salt, shallot, and garlic in a mortar with a pestle until smooth. Add the shrimp paste and mix to combine. Set aside.

Bring a large pan of water to a boil over medium heat. Add the jackfruit slices, reduce the heat to medium-low, and cook for 30 minutes or until tender. Drain, cut the flesh from the rind, and chop into small pieces. Set aside. Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the chopped garlic, and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Add the chili paste, cherry tomatoes, and jackfruit and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until everything is thoroughly combined. Garnish with kaffir lime leaves and serve.

recipes.searchText: Spicy Stir-Fried Jackfruit North 400 g young jackfruit, peeled and seeded wearing gloves, and cut into 3 cm slices 1 tablespoon vegetable oil 1 garlic cloves, chopped 10 cherry tomatoes, chopped 5 kaffir lime leaves, chopped, to garnish 15 dried red chiles, seeded a be as poon salt 5 shallots, chopped 10 g garlic cloves, sliced 1 teaspoon shrimp paste For the chili paste, soak the dried chiles in a bowl of warm water for 15 minutes or until rehydrated, then drain and chop. Pound the chiles, salt, shallot, and garlic in a mortar with a pestle until smooth. Add the shrimp paste and mix to combine. Set aside. Bring a large pan of water to a boil over medium heat. Add the jackfruit slices, reduce the heat to medium-low, and cook for 30 minutes or until tender. Drain, cut the flesh from the rind, and chop into small pieces. Set aside. Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the chopped garlic, and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Add the chili paste, cherry tomatoes, and jackfruit and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until everything is thoroughly combined. Garnish with kaffir lime leaves and serve.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Ivy Gourd with Pork
recipes.subtitle: South

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 4 handfuls ivy gourd or spinach leaves

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the pork, oyster sauce, sugar and ivy gourd or spinach leaves and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes or until cooked. Serve:.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Ivy Gourd with Pork South 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 3 cloves garlic, chopped 120 g ground (minced) pork side (belly) 1 tablespoon oyster sauce 1 teaspoon granulated sugar 4 handfuls ivy gourd or spinach leaves Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the pork, oyster sauce, sugar and ivy gourd or spinach leaves and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes or until cooked. Serve:.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Scallion Flowers with Pork Liver
recipes.subtitle: North

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 2-3 bunches scallions (spring onions) with flowers, cut into 2-3 cm lengths

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and pork liver and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until the pork is cooked.
Add the scallions and soy sauce, mix well, and serve.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Scallion Flowers with Pork Liver North 1 tablespoon vegetable oil 3 cloves garlic, finely chopped 100 g pork liver, finely sliced 2-3 bunches scallions (spring onions) with flowers, cut into 2-3 cm lengths 2 teaspoons soy sauce Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and pork liver and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until the pork is cooked. Add the scallions and soy sauce, mix well, and serve.

recipes.title: Spicy Stir-Fried Yard-Long Beans with Pork
recipes.subtitle: North

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 400 g pork side (belly), sliced into thin strips
175 g yard-long beans, cut into 2.5-5 cm lengths

ingredientGroups.heading: For the chili paste
lines: 3 dried red chiles, seeded and chopped

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: For the chili paste, soak the dried chiles in warm water for 15 minutes, or until rehydrated, then drain and chop. Pound the chiles, shallots, garlic, lemongrass, and galangal until smooth. Add the shrimp paste and mix to combine.
Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the chili paste and stir-fry for 1 minute, or until fragrant. Add the pork and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, or until cooked.
Add the yard-long beans, soy sauce, and sugar and stir-fry for another 4 minutes. Sprinkle with the kaffir lime leaves and serve.

recipes.searchText: Spicy Stir-Fried Yard-Long Beans with Pork North 1 tablespoon vegetable oil 400 g pork side (belly), sliced into thin strips 175 g yard-long beans, cut into 2.5-5 cm lengths 1 tablespoon soy sauce 1 teaspoon sugar 1 tablespoon chopped kaffir lime leaves 3 dried red chiles, seeded and chopped 2 shallots, chopped 7 garlic cloves, sliced 1 tablespoon chopped lemongrass 1 teaspoon finely chopped galangal 1 teaspoon shrimp paste For the chili paste, soak the dried chiles in warm water for 15 minutes, or until rehydrated, then drain and chop. Pound the chiles, shallots, garlic, lemongrass, and galangal until smooth. Add the shrimp paste and mix to combine. Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the chili paste and stir-fry for 1 minute, or until fragrant. Add the pork and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, or until cooked. Add the yard-long beans, soy sauce, and sugar and stir-fry for another 4 minutes. Sprinkle with the kaffir lime leaves and serve.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Cabbage
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 300 g Thai cabbage leaves (pointed spring cabbage), chopped into 8 cm chunks

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Mix the cabbage, fish sauce, garlic, and 2 tablespoons water in a bowl.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat. Add the cabbage mixture and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, or until cooked. Serve.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Cabbage Central 300 g Thai cabbage leaves (pointed spring cabbage), chopped into 8 cm chunks 1 tablespoon fish sauce 5 cloves garlic, finely chopped 2 tablespoons vegetable oil Mix the cabbage, fish sauce, garlic, and 2 tablespoons water in a bowl. Heat the oil in a wok over high heat. Add the cabbage mixture and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, or until cooked. Serve.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Cabbage with Dried Squid
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 300 g shredded napa (Chinese) cabbage (2.5 cm pieces)

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the dried squid and stir-fry for 1 minute or until cooked. Add the cabbage, soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon water and stir-fry for another 2 minutes. Serve.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Cabbage with Dried Squid Central 1 tablespoon vegetable oil 8 cloves garlic, finely chopped 50 g finely sliced dried squid 300 g shredded napa (Chinese) cabbage (2.5 cm pieces) 1 tablespoon soy sauce Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic, and stir-fry for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the dried squid and stir-fry for 1 minute or until cooked. Add the cabbage, soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon water and stir-fry for another 2 minutes. Serve.

recipes.title: Fried Spinach with Oyster Sauce
recipes.subtitle: Central

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Clean the spinach, shake off excess water, and remove the bottom 5 cm of the stems. Cut the remaining spinach into 4 cm lengths.

Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute, or until fragrant. Increase the heat to medium-high and add the spinach, oyster sauce, and soy sauce. Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, or until cooked, and serve.

recipes.searchText: Fried Spinach with Oyster Sauce Central 500 g Chinese spinach 3 tablespoons vegetable oil 5 cloves garlic, finely chopped 2 tablespoons oyster sauce 1⁄2 teaspoon soy sauce Clean the spinach, shake off excess water, and remove the bottom 5 cm of the stems. Cut the remaining spinach into 4 cm lengths. Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute, or until fragrant. Increase the heat to medium-high and add the spinach, oyster sauce, and soy sauce. Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, or until cooked, and serve.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Mekong River Seaweed
recipes.subtitle: North

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 120 g pork skin with fat, diced
1⁄2 garlic bulb, cloves separated and chopped

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the broiler to low. Broil the seaweed sheet until golden, then chop and set aside.
Broil the soybean sheet for about 2 minutes, or until fragrant and dark brown. Cool, then grind in a mortar.
Heat 120 ml of the oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add the pork skin and fry for 5 minutes, or until golden. Add the garlic and stir for 1 minute. Transfer to a plate.

Heat the remaining oil in the wok. Add the chili flakes and ground soybean sheet and stir-fry for 1 minute. Add the chopped seaweed, pork skin, and garlic and stir-fry for another 1-2 minutes, or until the pork is cooked. Season with salt, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and serve.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Mekong River Seaweed North 1 Mekong River seaweed sheet 1 Fermented Soybean Sheet (see p. 34) 150 ml vegetable oil 120 g pork skin with fat, diced 1⁄2 garlic bulb, cloves separated and chopped 1⁄2 tablespoon dried chili flakes 1⁄2 tablespoon salt 1 tablespoon white sesame seeds Heat the broiler to low. Broil the seaweed sheet until golden, then chop and set aside. Broil the soybean sheet for about 2 minutes, or until fragrant and dark brown. Cool, then grind in a mortar. Heat 120 ml of the oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add the pork skin and fry for 5 minutes, or until golden. Add the garlic and stir for 1 minute. Transfer to a plate. Heat the remaining oil in the wok. Add the chili flakes and ground soybean sheet and stir-fry for 1 minute. Add the chopped seaweed, pork skin, and garlic and stir-fry for another 1-2 minutes, or until the pork is cooked. Season with salt, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and serve.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Vegetables
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 5 amaranth leaves or spinach leaves, chopped

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the fried garlic, kale, amaranth, cabbage, and mushrooms and stir-fry for 4 minutes. Add the oyster sauce, fish sauce, and sugar and serve.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Vegetables Central 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 2 tablespoons Fried Garlic (see p. 64) 3 stems Chinese kale, chopped 5 amaranth leaves or spinach leaves, chopped 1⁄2 napa (Chinese) white cabbage, chopped 100 g enoki mushrooms 2 tablespoons oyster sauce 1 tablespoon fish sauce 11⁄2 teaspoons granulated sugar Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the fried garlic, kale, amaranth, cabbage, and mushrooms and stir-fry for 4 minutes. Add the oyster sauce, fish sauce, and sugar and serve.

recipes.title: Spicy Stir-Fried Water Spinach
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 300 g water spinach, chopped into 4-inch 10 cm lengths
3 red bird's eye chiles, diagonally sliced

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Put the chicken broth (stock), water spinach, garlic, chiles, oyster sauce, soybeans, and soy sauce in a bowl. Toss and set aside.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat. Carefully add the water spinach mixture and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes or until cooked. Serve.

recipes.searchText: Spicy Stir-Fried Water Spinach Central 80 ml chicken broth (stock) 300 g water spinach, chopped into 4-inch 10 cm lengths 4 cloves garlic, finely chopped 3 red bird's eye chiles, diagonally sliced 11⁄2 tablespoons oyster sauce 1 tablespoon salted soybeans 11⁄2 teaspoons soy sauce 2 tablespoons vegetable oil Put the chicken broth (stock), water spinach, garlic, chiles, oyster sauce, soybeans, and soy sauce in a bowl. Toss and set aside. Heat the oil in a wok over high heat. Carefully add the water spinach mixture and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes or until cooked. Serve.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Amaranth with Oyster Sauce
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 400 g amaranth leaves or spinach, chopped

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the fried garlic and amaranth leaves, and stir-fry for 4 minutes. Add the oyster sauce and sugar and serve.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Amaranth with Oyster Sauce Central 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 2 tablespoons Fried Garlic (see p. 64) 400 g amaranth leaves or spinach, chopped 3 tablespoons oyster sauce 1⁄2 teaspoons granulated sugar Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the fried garlic and amaranth leaves, and stir-fry for 4 minutes. Add the oyster sauce and sugar and serve.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Amaranth with Tofu and Garlic
recipes.subtitle: North

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 60 ml chicken broth (stock) pinch of ground white pepper

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add all the ingredients and stir-fry for 30-60 seconds or until the amaranth has softened. Serve.

recipes.searchText: Stir-Fried Amaranth with Tofu and Garlic North 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 200 g amaranth or spinach 2 tablespoons diced Erm tofu 11⁄2 teaspoons Fried Garlic (see p. 64) 1 tablespoon oyster sauce 1 tablespoon soy sauce 60 ml chicken broth (stock) pinch of ground white pepper Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add all the ingredients and stir-fry for 30-60 seconds or until the amaranth has softened. Serve.

recipes.title: Glutinous Rice
recipes.subtitle: North

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Soak the rice in a large bowl of cold water overnight or for at least 3 hours. Wash and drain. Wrap the rice in cheesecloth (muslin) and steam for 30-35 minutes, stirring the rice every 10 minutes until cooked through The rice will look transparent when cooked. Keep covered until ready to serve.

recipes.searchText: Glutinous Rice North 300 g uncooked glutinous (sticky) rice Soak the rice in a large bowl of cold water overnight or for at least 3 hours. Wash and drain. Wrap the rice in cheesecloth (muslin) and steam for 30-35 minutes, stirring the rice every 10 minutes until cooked through The rice will look transparent when cooked. Keep covered until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Steamed Jasmine Rice
recipes.subtitle: Central

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Wash the rice and drain through a strainer (sieve). Transfer to a large pan, pour in enough water to cover, and bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce the heat to low, cover the pan with a lid, and cook for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the rice is soil. Serve.

recipes.searchText: Steamed Jasmine Rice Central 400 g uncooked jasmine rice Wash the rice and drain through a strainer (sieve). Transfer to a large pan, pour in enough water to cover, and bring to a boil over medium heat. Reduce the heat to low, cover the pan with a lid, and cook for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the rice is soil. Serve.

recipes.title: Crab Fried Rice
recipes.subtitle: South

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 2 tablespoons fish sauce, plus extra to serve
2 cilantro stalks, chopped Juice of 1 lime
1 cucumber, peeled and sliced, to serve
2 scallions, to serve Lime wedges, to serve

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and sauté for 30 seconds.
Add the egg and stir until half-cooked. Increase the heat to medium-high and add the rice, crabmeat, onion, carrot, tomato, and scallions. Stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sugar and stir-fry for another 2 minutes.
Transfer to a plate and sprinkle with cilantro. Season with lime juice and serve with the cucumber, scallions, lime wedges, and extra fish sauce.

recipes.searchText: Crab Fried Rice South 3-4 tablespoons vegetable oil 5 cloves garlic, finely chopped 1 egg, beaten 175 g Steamed Jasmine Rice (see p. 378) 100 g crabmeat 1⁄2 onion, diced 4 tablespoons diced carrot 1⁄2 tomato, sliced 2 scallions, chopped 1 tablespoon soy sauce 1 tablespoon oyster sauce 1 tablespoon granulated sugar 2 tablespoons fish sauce, plus extra to serve 2 cilantro stalks, chopped Juice of 1 lime 1 cucumber, peeled and sliced, to serve 2 scallions, to serve Lime wedges, to serve Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat.
